notes.title: Optimization Update V2.1
notes.notes:
[list]

[*]Memory usage is reduced by 3 times. It will have a positive effect on the game stuck or crashing while loading. Unfortunately, it will only be effective for the new game, so if you want to play your old saved game, you won't be able to take advantage of this memory improvement, unfortunately this is the only way to play your old save file.

[*]We recommend that you make a backup of your save file. You can find your saved file as follows:
Press Windows + R -> enter %localappdata%low -> navigate to the Piratecat games folder -> make a backup of the Dating Simulator folder.

[*]Fixed a situation where some purchased items would later appear as if they were not purchased.

[*]Some localization deficiencies have been fixed.

Discord: https://discord.gg/Fue8XtE

[/list]

notes.title: THEME PARK UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996294/9aade12f32d700fc6d1d8520ef9962a1d3ea1e1b.png[/img]
- THEME PARK -
With this update, a theme park is coming to the Dating Simulator world. In this funfair, there are 11 different amusement rides that you can ride. You can either ride alone or spend a day with your match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996294/f9e9e381e84b216e4f6d82f5582e87c9ccb98115.png[/img]
- NEW JOB -
A new job has been added to the jobs where you can earn money. Start working at the ticket sales point in the amusement park, start selling tickets and earn money.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996294/01e8f191fe295385cb394c350c0604625f2795ae.png[/img]
Discord: https://discord.gg/Fue8XtE

notes.title: Hotfix V1.3
notes.notes:
Fixes:
Fixed a bug in the character creation screen that prevented the "CONFIRM" button from appearing or prevented the "ENTER" button from working after entering your character's name.
Fixed a bug when quitting a job.
Fixed a bug that caused you to do two jobs at the same time.
Fixed a bug where you would pick up the phone while shopping for clothes.
Fixed a bug where the house purchase screen always stays on the screen.
Fixed a bug when you get in the car with the Wiki page open.
Fixed the issue where the phone conversation stays on the screen.
Fixed the problem with buttons not being clicked during dialog.
Fixed translation errors.

Updates:
Added "Fix" button to the pause menu. You can use this button if you think you've encountered a bug. (Don't forget to tell us about bugs on Steam or Discord).
Lowered the minimum hunger, energy and libido required for Date.
You can now sleep again if 240 seconds have passed since you last slept.
Added information about Matching.
Limited the number of dishes to be washed to a maximum of 40.

Discord: https://discord.gg/Fue8XtE

V1.4
Missing translations corrected.

V1.5
Fixed an issue where high level charisma matches would get stuck on the "That's enough for today" screen.
Fixed the inability to interact with furniture thrown into a villa-type house.

V1.6
Fixed a bug where your fishing rod would disappear when you loaded the game.
Fixed a bug that prevented characters from appearing in bed.

The mini-game of putting on a condom is now easier.

notes.title: Hotfix V1.2
notes.notes:
•Fixed a bug that allowed you to walk through walls.
•Balancing for construction and fishing work.
•Adjustments have been made to car and house prices.
•Filling the character's hunger is now easier.
•General balancing.

notes.title: Hotfix V1.1
notes.notes:
